sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body: At its core, Barbie Doll Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle game where players are presented with a large image that needs to be reconstructed from various pieces. The game offers three difficulty levels - easy, medium, and hard - each with a different number of pieces to arrange. The easy mode comes with 25 pieces, medium with 49 pieces, and hard with 100 pieces. Players can use their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to drag and drop the pieces into place. The game also features a timer, which adds an extra layer of challenge and excitement to the gameplay. As players progress, the game becomes increasingly difficult, requiring them to think strategically and use their problem-solving skills to overcome obstacles. The core gameplay mechanics are simple yet engaging, making it easy for players to jump in and start playing right away.
